name: Emberknife
description: Monster effects also work on minions (for maps without a jungle), and Smite is this item's active. The item is not used up after 5 Smites - it keeps working while you own it.

passives.name: Sear
passives.description: Damaging a monster or minion burns it for 60 (+30% AP, +5% bonus AD, +2% bonus health) magic damage over 5s.

passives.name: Scavenger
passives.description: Heal for 7% of the damage you deal to monsters and minions.

passives.name: Recoup
passives.description: Away from enemies (no enemy champion, minion or summon within 1000 range; jungle monsters don't count), restore 8-18 (by level) mana per second.

passives.name: Huntsman
passives.description: Killing a large monster (or a melee minion) grants 10 bonus experience.

passives.name: Challenging Smite
passives.description: Champions hit by Challenging Smite are marked and revealed for 4s: your attacks and abilities burn them for 48-125 (by level) true damage over 2.5s, and they deal 20% less damage to you.

active.name: Smite
active.description: Deal 450 true damage to a monster or an enemy minion or summon. After 5 Smites (counted on the slot) it becomes Challenging Smite: 900 damage, and it can also mark an enemy champion for 4s.
active.requires: not t_ward and (not t_champion or counter('emberknife_smites') >= 5)
